description: Report a problem with your KaiCalls agent, phone number, billing, or account. Saves the report to your change history and notifies KaiCalls support so a person can follow up on anything broken or not working as expected.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

category.description: What part of the product this issue relates to.

description.description: Full details: what happened, what you expected, and any relevant call or time.

reporter_email.description: Email address support should reply to, if different from the account email.

severity.description: How badly this is affecting the business.

summary.description: One-line summary of the problem (max 200 characters).

name: report_issue
title: Report an Issue
